limitations_and_boundaries: The study was performed in gnotobiotic mice colonized with a defined bacterial consortium (Oligo-MM12), which may not fully recapitulate the complexity of the human gut microbiome.
Only three fungal species were tested; other early-life fungal colonizers may have different effects.
The causal mechanisms (e.g., immune regulation in white adipose tissue) were suggested but not fully elucidated.
Sex-specific effects were observed, but the underlying reasons were not explored.
The study did not assess long-term metabolic outcomes beyond 12 weeks.
Fungal colonization levels and stability over time were not reported in the provided chunks.

experiments_or_tasks: Body weight was measured weekly; body composition (fat mass, lean mass) was assessed by time-domain nuclear magnetic resonance (TD-NMR) at endpoint.

Germ-free C57BL/6 mice were colonized at weaning with a defined bacterial consortium (Oligo-MM12) alone (B only) or with one of three fungal species: Candida albicans (B+C), Rhodotorula mucilaginosa (B+R), or Malassezia restricta (B+M).
Mice were fed either standard chow (SD) or high-fat-high-sucrose diet (HFHS) from weaning until 12 weeks of age.
Oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) was performed at 12 weeks after a 6-hour fast.
Peri-gonadal fat pad weight was measured, and adipocyte size distribution was quantified from H&E-stained sections.
Plasma lipids, metabolic hormones, and cytokines were quantified from terminal cardiac puncture blood.

methods.name: Gnotobiotic colonization
methods.protocol_description: Germ-free C57BL/6 mice were colonized at weaning (3 weeks of age) with Oligo-MM12 bacterial consortium alone or with one of three fungal species. Mice were maintained in gnotobiotic isolators and fed either standard chow (SD) or high-fat-high-sucrose (HFHS) diet ad libitum.

methods.name: Body composition analysis
methods.protocol_description: Body composition (fat mass, lean mass) was measured by time-domain nuclear magnetic resonance (TD-NMR).

methods.name: Adipose tissue histology
methods.protocol_description: Peri-gonadal adipose tissue was fixed in 10% formalin, paraffin-embedded, sectioned at 4 μm, H&E stained, and imaged at 20X. Adipocyte size was quantified using Adiposoft plugin in ImageJ.

methods.name: Oral glucose tolerance test
methods.protocol_description: After 6-hour fast, mice were gavaged with 50% dextrose at 2 g/kg body weight. Blood glucose was measured from tail blood at 0, 15, 30, 60, 90, 120 min using OneTouch Ultra 2 glucometer.

methods.name: Plasma analysis
methods.protocol_description: Terminal cardiac puncture blood was collected with DPP-4 inhibitor and aprotinin, centrifuged at 2000×g for 10 min. Plasma lipids were quantified by Alberta Precision Laboratories; metabolic hormones and cytokines were measured using U-PLEX Metabolic Group 1 Mouse Assay kit on MESO QuickPlex SQ 120.
